# Pristine source snapshot

`jackett-v0.24.2360.tar.gz` is the GitHub commit archive downloaded from the URL recorded in `../UPSTREAM.toml`. It expands to `Jackett-0cd8622b735922a909a128d8d6943bb8565a640f/` and contains every tracked file at the selected commit. `SOURCE-MANIFEST.sha256` records the SHA-256 of each of the 963 tracked paths after extraction.

The source archive is not a shipping executable. The observed upstream release binaries are comparison references only and are intentionally not vendored.
